title: Frontmatter description still advertises extensions as buildable
reality: v2.3.4 removed the extension feature completely — all extension CSS/browser/server execution, Settings surface, client hooks, shared contract, and API routes are deleted; retained records and extension-storage:* settings are erased at startup; authoring guides and Mari extension instructions removed.
fix: Drop 'extensions' from the YAML description's ideation list and trigger phrase, or reframe as a redirect trigger.

title: Ideation-mode bullet lists 'an extension' as a buildable surface
reality: Extensions no longer exist as of v2.3.4; the buildable ideation surfaces are characters, lorebooks, custom tools, agents, and themes.
fix: Change '(a character, a lorebook, a custom tool, an agent, an extension)' to '...an agent, a theme)'.

title: Mode-detection text: 'including building extensions, themes, custom CSS/JS'
reality: Extension CSS/JS injection is gone in v2.3.4; themes survive as the only user-side look-and-feel surface.
fix: Rewrite to 'including building themes, lorebooks, custom tools, agents, or characters', with an optional redirect note for extension asks.

title: 'Extensions and themes are NOT contribution work' callout references removed extensions/ folder
reality: v2.3.4 deleted the extension feature; no extensions/ folder workflow exists. Themes remain user-installed and not contribution work.
fix: Rewrite the callout around themes/tools/lorebooks/cards; add the one-sentence removal + redirect (themes for appearance; downloadable packages or custom GitHub agent repos #3861 for functionality).

title: Reference table row still routes UI questions to references/extensions.md
reality: Upstream removed the extension feature and authoring guides in v2.3.4; a reference teaching the marinara client API / DOM injection documents a nonexistent surface.
fix: Replace the row with a themes row; the (tombstoned) extensions.md answers 'where did extensions go?' only.

title: Decision-guide table row lists 'extension' as a pickable approach
reality: Extension is no longer an architecture option in v2.3.4.
fix: Update the row to theme / agent package options.

title: Mode A intro lists 'extension, theme, custom CSS/JS' as deliverables
reality: Only themes survive v2.3.4.
fix: Change to '...custom tool, agent, **theme**'.

title: Decision hierarchy step 7: 'Client extension (CSS + JS with the marinara API)'
reality: The marinara client extension API, hooks, and CSS/JS execution were all deleted in v2.3.4. Look-and-feel → themes; new functionality/panels → downloadable agent packages (capability API) or custom GitHub agent repositories (#3861). No supported arbitrary-DOM-injection path.
fix: Replace step 7 with the appearance-vs-functionality split and the removal statement.

title: Limits list: 'without writing extensions' and 'CSS/JS extensions still have no marketplace'
reality: v2.3.4: extensions removed entirely (including manual install of extension files); startup erases retained extension records. The second distribution surface is now custom GitHub agent repositories (#3861). The 'outside that reviewed packaging path you still can't hook into prompt assembly without forking' claim remains true.
fix: Fix the Pinecone/Weaviate caveat (webhook tool + own backend); replace the two-surfaces bullet (official catalog + custom GitHub repos; extensions removed, retained data erased); keep the prompt-assembly forking note.

title: Version marker: '2.3.3 at the last reference sync'
reality: Current stable is v2.3.4 (2026-07-23).
fix: Update to 2.3.4.

title: Contributor Section 0 exemption list cites extensions and the extensions/ folder
reality: No extensions/ folder or extension work exists in v2.3.4; 'custom CSS/JS' outside themes is gone.
fix: Remove the Extensions exemption bullet; trim the themes bullet.

title: Pre-submission checklist exemption mentions extensions/custom CSS-JS
reality: Extensions removed in v2.3.4.
fix: Update the exemption to themes + user-side assets.

title: Android versionCode baseline stale (38 → 39)

fix: Update the baseline note.

title: No mention of custom GitHub agent repositories as a distribution/extension-replacement path
reality: v2.3.4 added disabled-by-default custom GitHub agent repositories to Agents Manager with manual preview/apply, explicit trust confirmation, stable sync identity, and bounded SSRF-safe archive validation (#3861). Combined with the extension removal, this is now THE third-party functionality path.
fix: Add to the limits list and/or the agents reference-table row: third-party agent packages via custom GitHub agent repositories (off by default, preview/apply, explicit trust; #3861) — recommend this, not extensions, for sharing functionality.

title: No mention that imported agent files no longer bundle functions or self-grant tools
reality: v2.3.4 (#3953): imported agent files can no longer install bundled custom functions, grant themselves tool access, or overwrite a curated Agent; exports no longer bundle function definitions; imports get a fresh custom identity and tools must be explicitly attached afterward.
fix: Add one line in the agents reference-table row or ideation calibration notes: don't promise that a shared agent file carries its functions with it (#3953).

title: Q6 'Does the UI itself need to change? → Client extension' documents a removed feature
reality: v2.3.4 deleted the entire extension feature: CustomThemeInjector-loaded CSS/JS, the scoped marinara API, the Settings surface, client hooks, shared contract, and API routes. Themes (native Appearance + server-synced /api/themes, Settings > Addons) survive. Functionality-level UI additions now only exist via downloadable capability packages or custom GitHub agent repositories (#3861).
fix: Rewrite Q6 as the theme question: native Appearance controls first, then custom themes; state plainly that client extensions were removed in 2.3.4 (no DOM injection, no marinara API, retained extension data erased at startup) and that word-count widgets/custom HUDs/injected buttons have no supported path — closest routes are an official package with client surfaces, a custom GitHub agent repo (#3861), or contributing upstream. Delete the 'See references/extensions.md for the API surface' pointer.

title: Q9 cross-references treat 'UI extension (Q6)' as a live surface
reality: Extensions no longer exist in v2.3.4.
fix: Change 'a UI extension (Q6)' to 'a theme (Q6)' and 'change the UI (that's an extension)' to 'change the UI's look (that's a theme)'.

title: 'Immersive RP character' stack recommends an optional extension HUD
reality: A custom HUD via extension is impossible in v2.3.4; overlay/HUD-style surfaces now only exist where an agent package provides them (e.g. the Tracker Panel).
fix: Replace '+ optional **extension** (custom HUD)' with '+ optional agent-package surface (e.g. the tracker panel)' or remove.

reality: v2.3.4 (#3887) added Grouped and Individual response modes with five selection strategies, a shared daily check-in budget, and a token-use warning; #3864 added explicit numeric check-in ceiling overrides. The mode-picker line gives the consultant nothing to configure for group chats.
fix: Extend the Conversation bullet: response modes, selection strategies, daily check-in budget, token-cost note (#3887).
